parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer raises three issues in the paper. It mentions "CodeChain" with "Likert scale judging by GPT-4 prompt," "sub-module generation," and "analysis on the chain of self-revisions." However, these are general topical references rather than explicit pointers to a section, table, figure, or other locatable part of the paper, so the authors cannot confidently determine which part each comment addresses. On the specificity side, the comment does clearly state what is wrong or unclear in each case: the unclear alignment of the GPT-4-based Likert evaluation with human preference, the unclear effectiveness of sub-module generation, and the slight performance drop in the 5th iteration hinting at a limitation of self-revise prompting. Thus, while the comment specifies the issues well, it lacks explicit grounding to identifiable parts of the paper.
